title: speclint results
description: Output of `speclint check`, optionally extended by `speclint merge`. Each item is graded from the severity caps of its active findings; an item without active findings gets "none".

profile.description: Profile the run used: a built-in name or the path of a profile file. Grades from different profiles are not comparable.

labels.description: Labels the profile asks the Haiku reviewer to set (rules.toml [labels]).

rules.description: Rule key to rule definition with its effective severity, for every rule the profile runs.

incose.description: INCOSE GtWR rule numbers the check is inspired by, e.g. "R7, R34".

needs_clarification.description: Graded items with at least one finding that is not dismissed.

categories.description: Findings per category over graded items, dismissed findings excluded.

grades.description: Number of graded items per grade, "none" included.

rules.description: Findings per rule over graded items, dismissed findings excluded.

dismissed.description: Findings dismissed in review, over all items.

labels.description: With labels in the profile: per label, graded items per value (a multi-value label counts each value).

safety_without_level.description: Graded items labelled safety-relevant that state no ASIL or SIL.

ears.description: With --ears: graded items per EARS pattern (patterns with no items are left out).

source.description: Input file the item was read from.

integrity.description: ASIL or SIL the text states ("ASIL B", "ASIL B(D)", "SIL 2"); never inferred.

labels.description: Set by `speclint merge` from the Haiku review; values from rules.toml [labels]. Never affects the grade.

classification.description: Requirement or information, when decided: model "input" (object type or heading in the input file), "obligation verb" (an obligation verb overrides an input "information"), or the reviewer model, e.g. "haiku" or "sonnet" (set by `speclint merge` for items neither decided).

review.description: Present after `speclint merge` for reviewed items.

model.description: Model that wrote this review (`merge --model`, default haiku).

unsure.description: Classification decisions ("kind" or label names) the reviewer was unsure about; `batches --unsure` sends these items to a stronger model.

question.description: Clarification question for the customer, in the item's language.

rewrite.description: Suggested text; unknown values appear as [TBD: ...] placeholders.

start.description: Character offset (Unicode code points) into the requirement text.

related.description: Whole-spec rules: the other items with the same finding. key is the position in requirements (IDs can repeat across files).

dismissed.description: Set by review; dismissed findings do not count towards the grade.
